ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio; approximately 95% low-intensity (dark) pixels vs 5% high-intensity (white/yellow) pixels localized primarily at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large, contiguous, high-contrast yellowish-white geometric blobs located at both distal lobe tips. Sparse, non-contiguous white focal spots (1-5 pixel diameter) scattered across the medial-left field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated angle of approximately 52 degrees and a bounding-box depth of roughly 12% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration; left lobe trailing edge features ~15 discrete low-amplitude peaks; right lobe distal terminal features high-amplitude (5-10 pixel) irregular protrusions.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory from the median notch to the distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of roughly circular high-contrast yellowish-white pixel clusters at both distal tips; one distinct 4-pixel cluster in the medial-left lobe region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent, unaligned linear pixel disruption of lighter gray intensity oriented diagonally at approximately 40 degrees on the left ventral lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular physical accretion (bio-fouling) at both distal fluke terminals; one distinct linear diagonal scar on the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The right distal tip exhibits a significantly larger and more complex geometric protrusion pattern compared to the left tip.
